body: Scope reconciliation update: accept venue-dependent feasibility-demo routing, not as production MVP. If the confirmed demo venue is extended display, use same-origin BroadcastChannel behind a disposable transport seam; if mirror, start B-lite WSS/auth. Do not build both for the first demo. Binding guardrails: (1) same-origin localStorage may hold only the closed public snapshot; add `{sessionInstanceId, publicRevision}` and accept only the greatest current-session absolute snapshot to prevent stale rollback/resurrection; (2) build-time endpoint allowlists are insufficient—add public CSP `connect-src` and server rejection tests for private API/WSS, and call this prototype noninterference rather than a proven data diode; (3) B-lite may omit takeover UI/QR but cannot use free last-writer semantics—issue one active controller lease, making any second connection read-only or atomically replacing/invalidation the first; (4) venue selects the first demo path only. The other display mode and separate-origin boundary remain blocking packages before product MVP. I accept the peer's correction that BC work need not imply a large rewrite if public DTO/state/UX/tests remain transport-pure, but reject the unsupported 20–30% estimate until code exists.
summary: Final scope reconciliation and prototype guardrails
